account-locked: Akhaonto ke temporarily e notletswe bofelo go le gone dintsi paletswe go tsena attempts. Tsweetswee try gape later.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ke ya SuperAdmin fela, mo domain ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ka WeKan mo Weddy, Cloud Panel e direla di-domain di le dintsi tsa WeKan go tswa mo seveng e le nngwe, nngwe le nngwe e na le data ya yone. Mo domain ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin o laola di-domain le CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ka selotlolo sa CloudFlare API, domain e zone ya yone e leng mo akhaontong ya gago ya CloudFlare e bona rekoto ya DNS e e fetang ka proxy le setifikeiti sa CloudFlare Origin. Di-domain tse dingwe di bona setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt. Selotlolo se bolokwa mo seveng mme ga se kitla se bontshiwa gape.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ga go na selotlolo sa CloudFlare API se se bolokilweng: domain nngwe le nngwe e bona setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Selotlolo sa CloudFlare API se bolokilwe.
error-ldap-login: E phoso occurred fa trying go go tsena
error-notAuthorized: Wena di ga authorized go leba eno tsebe.
